SERVICES (0,1,255)

MIX & MASTERING

I focus on clean, punchy mixes that keep the energy and character of the performance intact — modern where it matters, raw where it should be.

LIVE SOUND

From time to time I also do live sound when the right show comes along. It’s more of a side job and a passion than my main business. I simply enjoy making bands sound good on stage as much as in the studio.

REAMPING

A growing collection of old and new amps, cabinets, microphones and preamps gives plenty of options for finding the right guitar tone. From familiar classics to more unusual combinations. Always with character and high-quality results.

LIFE IS AGLITCH

Vision

My goal is simple: to get the best possible sound out of every project without turning great production into an unnecessary luxury. I want the band, the songs and the performances to come through at their strongest, keeping their character intact while giving them the clarity, weight and polish they deserve. No chasing trends for the sake of it, no overproduction. Just making sure the music reaches the listener in the best possible way.
